{{Top|leg}}
A '''safety cage''' was a device that provided an enclosed compartment made of some transparent material that allowed individuals to be transferred from the hangar bay of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to the main segment of the vessel. They were conveyed by a hoist. [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] were known to employ this device.

On one occasion, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] would snare a safety cage on the forward mandibles of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to take [[Odumin]] and [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] hostage after the Corporate Sector had attempted to seize his ship and imprison him. The host destroyer, unable to fire upon the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] vessel for fear of killing the two CSA officials, agreed to negotiate with Solo, which resulted in favorable terms for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]].
